Pranav Constructions Lists on Stock Exchange with 33% Premium

Pranav Constructions made its stock market debut on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) with shares listing at a 33% premium to their issue price. The company's shares opened at Rs 165. This marks a strong debut for the construction firm in the stock market.
